bars.says: At ordinary play zoom the Cauldron reads as a wet mineral forest on distinguishable dark soils beneath a dusk sky with rainless lightning, chemical fog and condensation rather than ordinary foliage or volcanic steam.

meant.intent: Reject if false: without the sourced mineral place this is vanilla forest in fog. Land, rederived from the experience sentence and frozen chemistry sheet; new art variants do not change the experience.

figurative.stands_for: A diffuse, shadowless, dim weather-tinted sky in the ruled weathers, not a fixed dusk light level or time of day; shared Direct Sun geometry remains unchanged.
figurative.accept: A day-phase frame on a supplied terminator-tail site still reads as diffuse scatter-dusk even though its light level is not the dusk colour table.

figurative.stands_for: Fog, dewfall weather and existing plant art give the place its moisture impression; no dew filth, decorative beads or weather-swapped plant colours are required.

accept: An intact map has ragged mineral trunks, attached metal crust/flecks and non-green cover above dark soils the player can distinguish while placing work; fog and condensation change the atmosphere and lightning arrives without rain.
The trunks have chemical filter fronds instead of a conventional leaf canopy; the sky can shift between the ruled chemical weathers without becoming sunny or volcanic.
reject: Only labels distinguish ordinary green woodland and generic grey fog, or mineral nuggets float beside unmineralised trees.
A steam geyser warms the forest, a dry storm rains, or ordinary and rich ground blend so the player cannot tell their usable patches apart.

Warm/cold fixed terminator-tail sites actually available, not alternative worlds.

bars.says: A Cauldron resident meets feeding and reproducing mineral-bodied native wildlife, predators and useful native harvests, with mineral bodies readable at ordinary zoom, retained non-mineral natives and owner-kept imports as stated exceptions, flying creatures actually flying and natives able to drink their environmental water.

meant.intent: Reject if false: a populated roster that starves, cannot drink or only walks despite flying fiction is scenery. Life includes ordinary products and living food chains, not deferred hazard embellishments; product amounts and movement tuning can change freely.

figurative.stands_for: The owner’s animals are minerals is figurative for living native bodies visibly bearing stone-like plates, mineral slag or crystal growth, with their retained mineral diets/products/remains; not literally inert rock statues or every organ made of stone. The mineral-body reading applies to zisska, vexxiss, crystalmit and ossrith. Suush retain translucent globes, eskith feathered foot pads, rhossak (including galled kin) living-root bodies and bedbugs insect bodies as non-mineral exceptions because those are their existing native designs; owner-kept imports likewise retain their admitted appearance. No new art is required. Life twists means mineral-shaped native life and the lasting metal/acid consequences in lasting_cost, not a separate mutation engine.
figurative.accept: At ordinary zoom a living zisska has rough stone-like plates and a vexxiss has mineral slag armour and crystal fans; flesh, movement and reproduction coexist with those mineral bodies. A translucent suush and an admitted imported creature beside them keep their existing non-mineral forms.

accept: Crystalmits consume actual loose mineral food, atmospheric suush live without a food need, predators catch prey, and foragers roast harvested tsevrix into food while raw toxic material remains identifiable.

Bound rhossak return toward living thornwood, rebind after its loss or visibly become unbound; galled kin remain seedless and yield edible galls, while a tame vexxiss supplies plate through ordinary shearing.
Flying natives enter real flight state and natives beside hazardous native water drink without dehydration; milk, eggs, silk, mineral products and carcasses come from actual animal actions.

At ordinary zoom native zisska stone-like plates and vexxiss mineral slag and crystal fans read as parts of living animal bodies, rather than nearby scenery; admitted imports keep their existing forms as exceptions.
reject: The map has animal portraits but native feeders starve beside their food or dehydrate beside their water, while harmless debug-spawned rations mask the loss.
A fictional flyer only walks, bound rhossak vanish when the tree dies, or killing a vexxiss is the only practical way to obtain its supposed living shear product.

The mineral-bodied natives named in range look like ordinary unmineralised fauna at play zoom and only their diet tooltips say they eat rocks, or mineral marks exist only in portraits while those bodies read as ordinary flesh; the stated non-mineral natives and imports do not excuse that failure.

sees.on: All kept mechanics at the proposed shipped defaults; all DLC and retained service providers loaded, including ExplosiveGrowth, FlowWorks, CreatureBehaviors, EnvironmentalHazards and ExplosiveKnockback; next-version extras off. Actual resolved settings and candidate/dependency hashes recorded. Weather, AI, needs, damage, ecology and research are unlocked; no god mode. sees.control: Ordinary ground fire spread or explosion splash can fake gas continuity or a breach. bars.says: By capping a vent and completing normal research, a prepared colony can collect condensate, refine useful reagent and detoxify local hazardous water with powered cartridge-fed Filter-Works, with readable stoppages that preserve stock.

meant.intent: Reject if false: the chosen successful day needs dependable useful production from the local danger. The converter, collector and necessary handling form the positive branch of the signature; discovery, shrine and machine upgrades are not needed.

Missing power, cartridges, input or output room explains a stopped machine; restoring the missing requirement resumes work without hidden stock loss or duplicate output.
reject: A completed research flag is debug-forced while the default rig-off research route is unreachable, a staged reagent pile substitutes for conversion, or capping only hides the cloud renderer.
A full tank silently deletes accepted fluid, a stalled converter burns cartridges indefinitely, or the only working setup needs an enabled next-version lined machine.

bars.says: Through a season of the complete Cauldron, prepared settlers keep useful forestry, food, drinking water and chemical work going amid recurring warned blooms, visible gas blasts that fling loose goods and dangerous expeditions, and resume the same livelihood after saving, reloading and reordering the work without runaway gas, ecological collapse, stalled work or an error storm.

meant.intent: Reject if false: isolated successful scenes do not supply the owner’s dependable livelihood. This alone is the whole bar; all kept mechanics meet under actual weather and normal needs. Enjoyment is predicted, not certified.
meant.source: OWNER:1794373071501926623 successful-day answer and CONDUCTOR:1794804951784038130; delegated seasonal scope from the cleansing brief’s whole requirement.

figurative.stands_for: Repeated attributable errors/exceptions that recur while the shipped systems run, rather than a literal meteorological storm.
figurative.accept: The season has no recurring exception stream even though an isolated unrelated diagnostic line is recorded and explained.

figurative.stands_for: On-map outdoor errands beyond shelter, such as forestry, vent work and pool hauling; caravans and off-map discovery sites are outside this seasonal scope.
figurative.accept: A colonist leaves the roof for a hazardous thornwood harvest and returns with timber on the same local map; no caravan is launched.

figurative.stands_for: A flood: connected combustible gas continually invading normal work routes, as defined by the coupled season model; not any transient plume or an isolated controlled burn.
figurative.accept: A vent plume briefly occupies an unused outdoor pocket while prepared work routes remain usable across the season; gas exists without a flood.

accept: Across the changing weather, the colony shelters or seals workers when necessary, harvests actual native supplies, processes water and condensate and still chooses hazardous outdoor tasks; live animals, mineral forest and contained work routes remain present.
The saved colony resumes during the vent cycle with its health, binding, fluids and work intact, then performs the main tasks in another order with the same available livelihood.
A visible explosion at the burning gas flings loose goods away from its source; their movement is seen as part of that burst.
reject: Only a cleared demonstration pad works while a full map becomes continuous combustible haze, a dead forest, a starving native population or a colony that spends all its time recovering from unavoidable routine exposure.
The seasonal presentation locks clear sky, disables damage or feeds need-free workers, or reload/reordered production double-pays stock, loses poisoning or floods the log with errors.
Gas ignition moves loose goods with no visible explosion at the burning cloud, or goods vanish and reappear rather than visibly being flung.
bars.lazy: none: The rejected shortcuts contradict explicit outcomes in says; no further build satisfying those outcomes was found in the second lazy-build attack.

range.varies: One whole bar: 15 game days on full 200x200, 250x250 and 325x325 local-map regimes at the supplied fixed-world sites, 3 and 40 colonists, arrival and established-colony starting stocks, early/late continuing saves including day-100 state. Save at the seasonal midpoint during live warning or production, plus active burn in gas_chain; reload same copy. Main orders: shelter/gear -> water/chemistry -> forestry versus forestry -> shelter/gear -> water/chemistry. Later work proceeds only with actual supplied or produced prerequisites; neither order promises immunity before protection. Ordinary raids/predation and weather interactions enabled, no forced god mode. If no natural bloom/burn occurs, the unscripted run remains recorded and is supplemented by an additional cycle, never replaced by a scene with the sky locked. Compression may accelerate real ticks only; preserve needs, AI, weather scheduler, plant growth, animal births/deaths, gas sweeps, dose cadence, work/fuel/storage and RNG/event order.
range.left_out: No claim of profitable play at every arbitrary price/rate, no unassisted barren arrival without imported water/medicine/components, no future extras enabled. Faction catastrophes unrelated to Cauldron do not establish a signature failure, but may not be silently removed; reproduce their Cauldron interaction with an attributable comparison. Flight visuals are judged only in an owner-present sitting; unattended readings use job and Pawn_FlightTracker state, with no images of flight. Expeditions here are on-map errands; no caravan or off-map site is part of this season run.

sees.instrument: Calibrated Coupled season and work model finds risky regimes; full-map ordinary-zoom live observation plus actual time-series/identity/stock/job/health/log state records decide the whole experience. Observe the gas-source explosion and goods being flung in the same ignition episode used for displacement traces; a visible burst without visible throwing, or position changes alone, cannot pass. Unattended live looks exclude flight visual judgement; use job/flight-tracker state for flyers and reserve their visuals for an owner-present sitting, with no images of flight.

checks.what: Existing preflight/selftest/runtime type and resolved-def inventory, fingerprints and clean log checks. Load, log and settings are inherited floors, never extra owner bars.

Record current/proposed yield, growth, work, grade thresholds, weather weights, rates, prices, animal products, resource/medicine costs and tunable limits as a diffable regression baseline. No declared-data count accepts or refuses a bar.
Read cue/bloom/dose tick sequence against R_warning nominal 2500 ticks and declared sampling tolerance. Timing is evidence for the warning experience; do not substitute a weather-transition constant.

Read R_protect shared complete-seal predicate at actual dose opportunities: max(final loaded VacuumResistance, final loaded ToxicEnvironmentResistance) >= 1.0 for both ambient acid and bloom. Sweep below/at/above full and gear-only, gene/hediff/race-only and mixed contributors, including no apparel; full ToxicResistance alone is not the seal. Compare eligible exposed controls and partial resistance routes. Material acid-proofing applies to the vexxith bottle, bucket, barrel or armour item, not its wearer without qualifying stats. Current bloom source omits VacuumResistance; this is an implementation gap, not a new passing bar.
Current RM_VentMetalLoad severityPerDay is -0.08 and treatment recipe absent; this is a construction gap, not an owner-approved effect. Assert no decay and treatable saved traces after construction.

Resolved terrain/LiquidDef/fluid chemistry and per-event decilitre ledger including tap bank conversion at 200 L per bank unit from RM_GasTap.cs. Validate conservation using declared actual registry ratios, not bar numbers.

Resolve XML element-name wildAnimals/wildPlants plus MayRequire and campaign patches; animalDensity positive. Maintain current membership and annotate shared species without cuts; native food/water and flight truth checks cover resolved life-state groups.

Enumerate actual initializer/Scribe/reset defaults and consumers, save roundtrip/application boundary, feature-off state and all-off/re-enable; build switches have behaviour tests, not just field roundtrips.

Existing soil texture hashes, Plant.Print bindings, fleck registration and variant audits support place; no asset count or opaque-pixel percentage becomes an owner bar. Preserve protected owner-kept art decisions.

At fresh-map defaults enumerate active extra comps/jobs/things/abilities/recipes/letters/incidents; each moved extra is absent as an effect, with retained base life alive. Inert loaded defs are allowed. Per-ticket positive opt-in controls prove gates rather than broken implementations.
Independent reads, deliberate wrong/missing values and wrong candidate, log-loss sentinel and interrupted recovery from checkpoint; anything unreadable is UNMEASURED, never false pass.

Record season weather, gas area/density/connectedness, fire/stock/health/job trajectories, food chain, births/deaths, import ledger and component cost. Thresholds and balance tuning are ours and revisable; whole experience decides passing.

rules.rule: Design Version 0.1.0 is proposed, not locked. Only land/life and the vent-cycle signature are on by default. Deferral preserves prior keep decisions for a future version; no owner keep, ruling, waiver or protected art is revoked. No game/build/bridge action is authorised by this folder.

The player receives the one fixed world. No alternate planet, world generation, biome scoring or rarity UI is a supported capability in any version. Local vents/pools/roster must be supplied on intended local maps through existing content preparation; a zero-world-tile count is never a defect.

Shared Direct Sun is the same geometric/solar-angle rule everywhere; ordinary weather attenuation and shade feed it. Dusk appearance adds no Cauldron heat kind, sun offset or exemption. Chemical vents add no heat, steam or volcanism.

Keep scatter-dusk, vapour bank, dewfall, vent bloom and welcomed dry thunderstorms; no rain/snow weather. Dewfall is condensation and a wet-surface description, not a new touch-dose system. No bespoke audio; vanilla sound remains. The recorded dewfall green exception stands; ordinary non-dew foliage remains non-green apart from specifically kept imports.

Designer timing default: 2500 ticks nominal cue-to-full-bloom, independent of vanilla 4000-tick blend, with sampling tolerance 250 ticks for the check. First harmful dose is separately timed after onset. The approximate owner hour is not a repeat-acceptance tuning number. Keep the timed warning message even when all sources are capped or absent; native hush and its flight-specific positional rule are next-version, default off.

Roof and a functional complete environmental seal independently block ambient acid/bloom on eligible bodies. Designer seal predicate, shared by RM_AcidAir and RM_VentBloomExposure at each exposure opportunity: max(pawn.GetStatValue(VacuumResistance), pawn.GetStatValue(ToxicEnvironmentResistance)) >= 1.0. Both use these same final loaded pawn stats, counting all contributing sources, including apparel, genes, hediffs and race; no suit-piece requirement is added. Accept edge: an unroofed otherwise eligible pawn with full ToxicEnvironmentResistance supplied by a gene is sealed without a suit. Reject edge: treating that pawn as unsealed solely because it lacks apparel, or treating full ToxicResistance alone as the complete seal. Existing load remains. Below full seal, each hazard retains its actual loaded partial-resistance math and named immunity routes. Acid-proof material protects the bottle, bucket, barrel or armour item itself; it grants the wearer no body immunity apart from actual pawn stats. Native adaptation, condition immunity, direct contact and combustion smoke retain named shared routes. These are Designer build choices, not additional owner bars.

Exposure follows active uncapped sources with shared weather/recovery state and a residual ambient floor, weaker far from sources; capping cannot remove stored clouds or already acquired load. Capping stops new emission while the same vent output feeds condensate collection. Carry forward saved suppressed/recovering vents without adding default drinking.

Retain separate byte grid and vanilla-like diffusion/dissipation; leave other gas storage alone except toxic smoke deliberately produced. All emission/overflow/drift/ignition paths obey current sealed geometry; a diagonal requires both cardinal side cells open. The same combustible connectivity applies over water. Pending fronts and original instigators survive saving; ExplosiveKnockback owns the bursts and displacement.

No natural or ordinary-care removal of positive metal load. Designer advanced-medicine default is MedicineIndustrial (or higher) in a dedicated normal purge bill, selectable even for hidden saved traces; ordinary tending with the same medicine does not purge. Success removes load; interruption/failure follows vanilla accounting and does not count as purge. Supply at shipped defaults: finite arrival industrial medicine covers setup, then ordinary DrugProduction/MedicineProduction research and the vanilla drug-lab recipe use harvested selvix MedicineHerbal, cloth and neutroamine. Sell the retained Filter-Works RM_VentReagent through ordinary orbital trade using a powered comms console and trade beacon to replenish cloth/neutroamine; no off-map site, rig discovery or next-version feature is required. Use actual loaded recipe, trader acceptance/stock and prices, never assume reagent is itself neutroamine or medicine. Buffer delivery gaps with declared stock and shelter/sealed duties; quantify shortages and labour in the coupled season model through day 100, with no automatic refills. Actual acid uses vanilla lasting-part/disfigurement/capacity state; exceptional restoration remains possible.

Default Filter-Works uses normal Electricity prerequisite and bench research. Deferred requiredAnalyzed/rig study cannot gate the shipped converter. Do not debug-unlock it for default reachability proof.

FlowWorks owns actual liquid/fluid identity, decilitre stock, material compatibility, converters and explicit losses. Tap is a local collector, not a network member: output requires a tank touching any edge/corner of its footprint. Whole bank units are delivered once, never to an incompatible/full tank. Readable blocked machines stop accepted input/fuel processing.

Retain all current admitted animals and plants; do not evict imports or shared species. Keep ordinary diets, births, predation, food/material products and owner-ruled rhossak binding; defer identified side effects only. Native animals can drink their environmental water; a fictional flyer has real flight, judged visually only with the owner. Death/departure has readable remains/signs, never a silent vanish. Ordinary shared-neighbour mechanics stay with their owners.

Normal successful PlantWork alone produces growth-scaled additional metal; interrupted/failed work does not. Assay predicts current expected payout without consuming RNG, installed flecks attach to the trunk and follow its maturity. Work/yield/grade cutoffs are provisional checks; no new age coat is required.

Expose searchable, scrollable, persistent on/off controls per major kept feature and label now/restart/new-local-map boundaries. Defaults implement this proposal, extras off. Separate mixed suit/container/machine/hull gates. All-off prevents new effects at the advertised boundary without destroying stock, bodies, bindings or curing health; re-enable cannot duplicate work. Existing unsupported cross-biome switches stay off.

Every acceptance run fingerprints candidate, DLC/providers, actual settings, state and ticks; all other kept mechanics stay on and weather is unlocked. No scene accepts missing reads. Independent controls and checkpoint recovery precede staging. A model is a prediction until calibrated against actual engine actions, never a game measurement by itself.

meetings.why: Fixed-map preparation supplies soils, pool and organisms together. Dusk/rainless appearance is ordinary weather attenuation, not a new heat law; shared Direct Sun still uses supplied tile geometry. Deferral removes decorative generators, not base wet/mineral art. No new world is needed.

Natural weather simultaneously changes warning, local dose, gas emission and collector throughput; capped sources can protect work yet reduce visible puffs. Pairwise timing checks cannot establish a recurring readable useful cycle or avoid long bloom/resource overlap.

Ordinary regrowth, timber removal, predation, native drinking, VEF fission, food harvest, shared-neighbour behaviours and stalled terminator growth can produce collapse or overpopulation together. Deferred renewal cannot be silently enabled to rescue the result.

The same tree growth is read by assay/flecks and harvest; the assay cue is checked visually by place and by source-linked payouts in timber. Retained animals bind to existing trees but never need deferred rooting to create a payout. A loss of all harvestable trees is checked by ecology/whole, not rescued by a scripted root.

Prevention, persistence and treatment are distinct: shelter prevents new ambient harm, never clears old load; advanced treatment removes only metal; ordinary healing leaves genuine permanent acid part damage, while exceptional restoration remains vanilla. Native water immunity concerns native drinking, not a human cure. Flooding of health over real duties remains unknown in exposure/colony_work. R_health supplies the renewable industrial-medicine route: selvix harvest plus ordinary drug-lab production, with cloth/neutroamine bought using chemical_work reagent output through normal on-map orbital trade. These existing members cover medicine supply as well as its use; neither residual exposure nor ordinary tending creates medicine or cures load. Finite setup stock and sheltered/sealed work bridge production/research and trade gaps. This argues reachability, not adequacy at every rate; consumption, trade availability and buffer exhaustion remain unknown in colony_work and must be calibrated.

Keep gates independent and non-destructive. Turning off a deferred garden cannot disable vents; turning off an upgraded vessel cannot hide normal suits/containers; deferring rig study cannot strand ordinary research. Feature-off is a declared user mode rather than whole-bar shipped defaults; core acceptance always restores the complete default system.

Three-way feedback: lower exposure permits work; tapping/capping and weather change resources/dose; illness and food/water labour reduce protection and production capacity. A roster or converter that works alone cannot establish a manageable prepared colony. Both task orders and late saves must run with ordinary needs. Medicine supply is an explicit R_health/chemical_work member interaction: reagent sold for cloth/neutroamine, selvix harvested, normal drug-lab medicine made and consumed by purge bills. Model research/build lead time, power, trader access and finite stock/currency, shared cloth demand from cartridges, trade gaps, treatment demand and medical labour; finite initial medicine cannot conceal a nonrenewing route through day 100.

Tap source output, fractional bank, full/incompatible tanks, normal converter/fuel pauses, contact chemistry and ordered/reloaded work can drop or double stock at transitions. Item and liquid ledgers must agree including harvest and medical resource consumers; only declared actual spills/losses may leave the system.

Ambient acid, bloom dose, local cap state, complete sealing and separately produced smoke overlap; one healthy arm can hide a missed cadence or native exemption. Full reachable state coverage and actual injury/purge cause need the medical model before a whole-season safety claim.

Use stable IDs and actual serialisation for health, bound trees, gas/front/instigator, bank, liquids, research and settings. The same saved state is resumed; component-specific continuity remains an implementation obligation, not permission to reset a failed scene. In-progress histories are enumerated in the gas, fluid and health unknown meetings.

A roof protects ambient bodies but is not a sealed gas wall. Emission overflow, diagonal drift, 3x3 fire offers, capped front scans and blast callbacks meet; current front is transient on save and Ignite does not check the origin-to-target sealed corner. Must enumerate the actual adapter, not just kernel diffusion.
